parameters.name: -help
parameters.help: Print command line help and exit.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Print command line help and exit.

parameters.name: -version
parameters.help: Print version information and exit.

parameters.name: -doc
parameters.help: Generate markdown documentation of command line parameters. Optional: [file] (default: cmdline.md)

parameters.name: -beta
parameters.help: Beta emulation mode. Requires betagrph.wad.

parameters.name: -config
parameters.help: Load main configuration from the specified file, instead of the default.

parameters.name: -nooptions
parameters.help: Do not load the default configuration file.

parameters.name: -nosound
parameters.help: Disable all sound output.

parameters.name: -nomusic
parameters.help: Disable music.

parameters.name: -nosfx
parameters.help: Disable sound effects.

parameters.name: -file
parameters.help: Load the specified PWAD files.

parameters.name: -iwad
parameters.help: Specify an IWAD file to use.

parameters.name: -save
parameters.help: Specify a path from which to load and save games. If the directory does not exist then it will automatically be created.

parameters.name: -shotdir
parameters.help: Specify a path to save screenshots. If the directory does not exist then it will automatically be created.

parameters.name: -skill
parameters.help: Set the game skill, 1-5 (1: easiest, 5: hardest). A skill of 0 disables all monsters only in -complevel vanilla.

parameters.name: -uv
parameters.help: Alias to -skill 4 (Ultra-Violence).

parameters.name: -nm
parameters.help: Alias to -skill 5 (Nightmare).

parameters.name: -episode
parameters.help: Start playing on episode n (1-99).

parameters.name: -warp
parameters.help: Start a game immediately, warping to ExMy (Doom 1) or MAPxy (Doom 2).

parameters.name: -wart
parameters.help: Alias for -warp.

parameters.name: -nomonsters
parameters.help: Disable monsters.

parameters.name: -nomo
parameters.help: Alias for -nomonsters.

parameters.name: -nocheats
parameters.help: Disable cheat codes.

parameters.name: -respawn
parameters.help: Monsters respawn after being killed.

parameters.name: -fast
parameters.help: Monsters move faster.

parameters.name: -pistolstart
parameters.help: Enables automatic pistol starts on each level.

parameters.name: -coop_spawns
parameters.help: Start single player game with items spawns as in cooperative netgame.

parameters.name: -dog
parameters.help: Enables a single helper dog.

parameters.name: -dogs
parameters.help: Overrides the current number of helper dogs, setting it to n.

parameters.name: -turbo
parameters.help: Turbo mode. The player's speed is multiplied by x%. If unspecified, x defaults to 200. Values are rounded up to 10 and down to 400.

parameters.name: -loadgame
parameters.help: Load the game on page p (0-7) in slot s (0-7). Use 255 to load an auto save.

parameters.name: -chain_episodes
parameters.help: Completing one episode leads to the next without interruption.

parameters.name: -server
parameters.help: Start a multiplayer server, listening for connections.

parameters.name: -dedicated
parameters.help: Start a dedicated server, routing packets but not participating in the game itself.

parameters.name: -connect
parameters.help: Connect to a multiplayer server running on the given address.

parameters.name: -autojoin
parameters.help: Automatically search the local LAN for a multiplayer server and join it.

parameters.name: -privateserver
parameters.help: When running a server, don't register with the global master server. Implies -server.

parameters.name: -solo-net
parameters.help: Run a solo network game (for testing).

parameters.name: -port
parameters.help: Use the specified UDP port for communications, instead of the default (2342).

parameters.name: -servername
parameters.help: When starting a network server, specify a name for the server.

parameters.name: -timer
parameters.help: For multiplayer games: exit each level after n minutes.

parameters.name: -avg
parameters.help: Austin Virtual Gaming: end levels after 20 minutes.

parameters.name: -deathmatch
parameters.help: Start a deathmatch game.

parameters.name: -altdeath
parameters.help: Start a deathmatch 2.0 game. Weapons do not stay in place and all items respawn after 30 seconds.

parameters.name: -dm3
parameters.help: Start a deathmatch 3.0 game. Weapons stay in place and all items respawn after 30 seconds.

parameters.name: -norollback
parameters.help: Disable rollback netcode.

parameters.name: -oldsync
parameters.help: Use original network client sync code rather than the improved sync code.

parameters.name: -extratics
parameters.help: Send n extra tics in every packet as insurance against dropped packets.

parameters.name: -dup
parameters.help: Reduce the resolution of the game by a factor of n, reducing the amount of network bandwidth needed.

parameters.name: -left
parameters.help: Run as the left screen in three screen mode.

parameters.name: -nodes
parameters.help: Autostart the netgame when n nodes (clients) have joined the server.

parameters.name: -frags
parameters.help: The -frags option allows you to deathmatch until one player achieves n frags, at which time the level ends and scores are displayed. If n is not specified the match is to 10 frags.

parameters.name: -playdemo
parameters.help: Play back the demo named demo.lmp.

parameters.name: -record
parameters.help: Record a demo named demo.lmp.

parameters.name: -recordfrom
parameters.help: Record a demo, loading from the given save slot. Equivalent to -loadgame <slot> -record <demo>.

parameters.name: -recordfromto
parameters.help: Allows continuing <demo1> after it ends or when the user presses the join demo key, the result getting saved as <demo2>. Equivalent to -playdemo <demo1> -record <demo2>.

parameters.name: -fastdemo
parameters.help: Plays the given demo as fast as possible.

parameters.name: -timedemo
parameters.help: Play back the demo named demo.lmp, determining the framerate of the screen.

parameters.name: -levelstat
parameters.help: Write level statistics upon exit to levelstat.txt.

parameters.name: -shorttics
parameters.help: Play with low turning resolution to emulate demo recording.

parameters.name: -longtics
parameters.help: Use high turning resolution for demo recording.

parameters.name: -tas
parameters.help: Lifts strict mode restrictions according to DSDA rules.

parameters.name: -skipsec
parameters.help: Skip min:sec time during viewing of the demo. "-warp <x> -skipsec <min:sec>" will skip min:sec time on level x.

parameters.name: -statdump
parameters.help: Dump statistics information to the specified file on the levels that were played. The output from this option matches the output from statdump.exe (see ctrlapi.zip in the /idgames archive).

parameters.name: -maxdemo
parameters.help: Sets the initial size of the demo recording buffer (KiB). This is no longer a hard limit, and the buffer will expand if the given limit is exceeded.

parameters.name: -dumptranmap
parameters.help: Dump tranmap lump, given an alpha level (opacity percentage). Valid values are 0 through to 99.

parameters.name: -complevel
parameters.help: Emulate a specific version of Doom/Boom/MBF. Valid values are "vanilla", "boom", "mbf", "mbf21".

parameters.name: -cl
parameters.help: Alias for -complevel.

parameters.name: -gameversion
parameters.help: Emulate a specific version of Doom. Valid values are "1.9", "ultimate", "final", "final2", "chex". Requires -complevel vanilla.

parameters.name: -force_old_zdoom_nodes
parameters.help: Force use of old ZDoom node builder.

parameters.name: -fullscreen
parameters.help: Start in fullscreen mode.

parameters.name: -window
parameters.help: Start in windowed mode.

parameters.name: -borderless
parameters.help: Start in borderless windowed mode.

parameters.name: -noblit
parameters.help: Disable blitting the screen.

parameters.name: -nodraw
parameters.help: Disable rendering the screen entirely.

parameters.name: -nograbmouse
parameters.help: Don't grab mouse cursor.

parameters.name: -uncapped
parameters.help: Uncapped framerate mode.

parameters.name: -nouncapped
parameters.help: Disable uncapped framerate mode.
Don't scale up the screen. Implies -window.
Double up the screen to 2x its normal size. Implies -window.
Triple up the screen to 3x its normal size. Implies -window.

parameters.name: -deh
parameters.help: Load the given dehacked/bex patch(es).

parameters.name: -nodeh
parameters.help: Avoid loading DEHACKED lumps embedded into WAD files.

parameters.name: -noautoload
parameters.help: Disable auto-loading of .wad and .deh files.

parameters.name: -nomapinfo
parameters.help: Disable UMAPINFO loading.

parameters.name: -blockmap
parameters.help: Forces a (re-)building of the BLOCKMAP lumps for loaded maps.

parameters.name: -bsp
parameters.help: Forces rebuilding of nodes.

parameters.name: -reject_pad_with_ff
parameters.help: Pad reject map with 0xFF.

parameters.name: -tranmap
parameters.help: Forces the (re-)building of the translucency table.

parameters.name: -setmem
parameters.help: Specify DOS version to emulate for NULL pointer dereference emulation. Supported versions are: dos622, dos71, dosbox. The default is to emulate DOS 7.1 (Windows 98).

parameters.name: -nogui
parameters.help: Don't pop up a GUI dialog box to show the error message.

parameters.name: -spechit
parameters.help: Use the specified magic value when emulating spechit overruns.

parameters.name: -quiet
parameters.help: Suppress non-error output.

parameters.name: -verbose
parameters.help: Enable verbose output.

parameters.name: -devparm
parameters.help: Developer mode. Enables extra debug output and features.
